repairs.quote: Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them (8% + (0.8% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed, herself (20% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) decaying Move Speed and both (60/80/100/120/140 + (20% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds. If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring 8/10/12/14/16% missing Health to them after a 2.5 second delay. This Ability only heals once, even if cast twice.

limitations.detail: 원문이 회복량을 missing Health에 비례한다고 표현하지만, 현재 스키마의 통계 목록에는 잃은 체력을 정확히 나타내는 항목이 없습니다. 특정 체력 통계로 바꾸지 않고 원문 표현을 유지했습니다.
